Write FASTA file with optional read counts

Source: R/vtamR_fun.R
write_fasta_with_counts.Rd

Writes a FASTA file from a data frame, optionally including read counts in the sequence headers.

Usage

write_fasta_with_counts(df, outfile, read_count = FALSE)

Arguments

df

Data frame containing at least asv_id and asv columns, and optionally read_count.

outfile

Character string: output FASTA file name.

read_count

Logical: if TRUE, include read counts in FASTA headers using ;size= format.

Value

NULL; writes a FASTA file to disk.

Details

If read_count = TRUE, definition lines are written in the format >label;size=###. If read_count = FALSE, definition lines are written in the format >label.
